FileHelper - Class in paint.viewer.io
Static utility class providing file operations for the PAINT Viewer, including: Exporting Swing components as high-resolution PNG images Filtering a project's squares.csv to a temporary CSV Automatically opening filtered results via Desktop integration Instantiation is prevented via a private constructor.
filterAndOpenSquaresCsv(Path, String, String) - Static method in class paint.viewer.io.FileHelper
Extracts only the rows from an experiment's squares.csv matching the given recording name, writes them to a temporary CSV file, marks the file read-only, and opens it using the desktop's default CSV viewer.
